title: Device-scoped profile assigned to user groups, or the reverse

report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'profile is', 'profiles are')} assigned to the wrong kind of group

messages.businessImpact: Settings that apply to a machine are targeted at people, or the other way round, so the policy applies unpredictably and often not at all.
remediation: Retarget device settings to device groups and user settings to user groups.
Where a profile contains both, split it.
